q: The Rath Yatra of Lord Jagannath is held every year at:
e: Puri's Rath Yatra takes Jagannath, Balabhadra and Subhadra to the Gundicha temple.

q: Odissi is the classical dance form of:
e: Odissi originated in the temples of Odisha.

q: The Kalinga War, which transformed Ashoka, was fought in present-day:
e: Ashoka's Kalinga War (c. 261 BCE) was fought near Dhauli in present-day Odisha.

q: Chilika, in Odisha, is India's largest:
e: Chilika Lake is the largest brackish-water lagoon in India and a Ramsar site.

q: The Hirakud Dam, among the longest earthen dams in the world, is built on:
e: Hirakud Dam near Sambalpur is on the Mahanadi.

q: Pattachitra, a traditional cloth-based scroll painting, is associated with:
e: Pattachitra of Odisha, especially from Raghurajpur, depicts Jagannath and mythological themes.

q: The Lingaraj Temple, dedicated to Lord Shiva, is in which city?
e: The 11th-century Lingaraj Temple is the largest temple of Bhubaneswar.

q: Paradip in Odisha is known as a major:
e: Paradip, at the mouth of the Mahanadi, is one of India's major ports.

q: The Konark Sun Temple was built by which Eastern Ganga ruler?
e: Narasimhadeva I built the Sun Temple at Konark in the 13th century.

q: Simlipal National Park is located in which district of Odisha?
e: Simlipal Tiger Reserve is in Mayurbhanj district.

q: Bhitarkanika National Park in Odisha is famous for mangroves and the:
e: Bhitarkanika hosts one of India's largest populations of saltwater crocodiles.

q: Gahirmatha beach in Odisha is world-famous as a mass nesting site of:
e: Gahirmatha sees the arribada (mass nesting) of Olive Ridley sea turtles.

q: Utkal Divas is celebrated on 1 April to mark Odisha's formation as a separate province in:
e: Odisha became a separate province on 1 April 1936.

q: The name of the state was officially changed from Orissa to Odisha in:
e: The Orissa (Alteration of Name) Act, 2011 changed the name to Odisha.

q: Raja Parba, a three-day festival of Odisha, celebrates:
e: Raja Parba in mid-June celebrates womanhood and Mother Earth before the monsoon.

q: Tarakasi, the fine silver filigree work of Odisha, is mainly associated with:
e: Cuttack is famous for Tarakasi silver filigree.

q: Which Odia social reformer and freedom fighter was given the title 'Utkalmani'?
e: Pandit Gopabandhu Das was called Utkalmani (Gem of Utkal).

q: The Hathigumpha inscription in the Udayagiri caves describes the achievements of which king?
e: Kharavela of the Mahameghavahana dynasty recorded his deeds in the Hathigumpha inscription.

q: Odia was declared a classical language of India in which year?
e: Odia became the sixth classical language in 2014.

q: What is the state bird of Odisha?
e: The Indian roller (Blue Jay) is the state bird of Odisha.
